title: Saved: kept in its month
note: The save commits first, then the sheet files into its month: "Kept in Month N" under it and "Added to Asha's book." with a check, never ghosted words (S21).
text: To Asha · Month 7 From Mama Asha, today you held the spoon by yourself. You mostly painted your face with it, but you were so so proud. I want you to know that I was too.
